blocks.title: Image exploitation made simple
blocks.text: Part of the Esri Geospatial Cloud, ArcGIS Excalibur is a project-based imagery application that modernizes and enhances image-based workflows through intuitive experiences. View drone, aircraft, or satellite imagery as collected along with authoritative geospatial contextual and operational layers. Assign and manage imagery exploitation tasks across the organization. Compile, publish, share, and disseminate dynamic information products to consumers and devices in multiple formats.

blocks.title: Dynamic web-based imagery workflows
blocks.text: A new way for analysts, imagery specialists, and managers to collaborate and deliver timely geospatial intelligence to decision makers.
